title: vibe-bar-i18n-v1
description: One language catalog. A flat map of stable dotted key to entry, so the file diffs by key and a translator never has to reason about nesting. Files beginning with '_' in this directory are metadata, not catalogs. Placeholders are named and brace-delimited ({provider}, {days}); printf specifiers are rejected, because the positional order they encode is exactly what a second language reorders and because the cross-platform client cannot render them. Plurals are ICU (`{count, plural, one {...} other {...}}`) with '#' standing for the number; Simplified Chinese has only the 'other' category and English needs 'one' and 'other'. Only Scripts/build_localizations.py reads these files - it compiles them into .strings, .stringsdict and a typed Swift API, all checked in, so no build depends on this directory or on Python.

propertyNames.description: Surface scope, then a dotted path. The scope says where the string is read. 'platform.macos.*' is for copy only one client can ever show; everything else must be renderable by a React client too.

value.description: The string as the user reads it. Terms in _glossary.json stay spelled exactly as that file spells them, in every language.

comment.description: Translator note: where the string appears and what the arguments are. Authored once, in en.json, and repeated into every generated catalog. Present only in the base language.

args.description: Argument types, declared once in en.json. A placeholder that is not listed is a string. 'double' does not exist on purpose: how a number reads is a locale decision that belongs in one formatter, so a decimal is formatted at the call site and arrives here already spelled.
